tool_signatures.name: photopea_add_fill_layer
tool_signatures.description: Add a non-destructive solid color fill layer that covers the entire canvas. Unlike fill_selection, this creates a separate adjustment-style layer that can be toggled, recolored, or deleted without affecting other layers. Use set_layer_properties to change its opacity or blend mode.

name.description: Display name for the fill layer in the layers panel

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Fill color as hex string (e.g. #ff0000)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Display name for the fill layer in the layers panel

tool_signatures.name: photopea_add_gradient
tool_signatures.description: Apply a linear gradient fill to a layer, replacing its current pixel content. The target layer must already exist — use add_layer to create one first. Colors are distributed evenly across the gradient.

angle.description: Gradient angle in degrees (0 = left-to-right, 90 = top-to-bottom, default 0)

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: Gradient angle in degrees (0 = left-to-right, 90 = top-to-bottom, default 0)

tool_signatures.name: photopea_add_layer
tool_signatures.description: Add a new empty layer to the active document. The new layer becomes the active layer. Use this before operations that draw onto a layer, such as fill_selection or add_gradient.

opacity.description: Layer opacity percentage (0 = fully transparent, 100 = fully opaque, default 100)

tool_signatures.name: photopea_clear_selection
tool_signatures.description: Deselect the current selection in the active document, removing the marching ants. Does not modify any pixel data. Use after fill_selection or other selection-based operations are complete.

tool_signatures.name: photopea_export_image

tool_signatures.name: photopea_fill_selection
tool_signatures.description: Fill the current selection with a solid color on the active layer. Requires an active selection — use make_selection to create one first. Modifies pixel data on the active layer directly. Use clear_selection afterward to deselect.

opacity.description: Fill opacity percentage (0 = fully transparent, 100 = fully opaque, default 100)

tool_signatures.name: photopea_get_document_info
tool_signatures.description: Get metadata about the active document including name, width, height, resolution (DPI), layer count, and color mode. Returns JSON. Use this to check document dimensions before positioning layers or making selections.

tool_signatures.name: photopea_get_layers
tool_signatures.description: Get the full layer tree of the active document as JSON. Returns an array of layer objects with name, type, index, visible, opacity, blendMode, and bounds properties. Groups contain nested children arrays. Use this to discover layer names and indices for other layer operations.
